evidence: Agent image: task/environment/Dockerfile (byte-identical to template per diff) builds from the environment/ context only and copies just instructions/ (L14) and assets/ (L15); it installs node 22, git, sqlite3, express, better-sqlite3 (L5-12) - no claude-code/codex judge CLI, no playwright-mcp, no harbor-rewardkit, no tests/ or criteria. The environment/ tree holds only Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json, instructions/hireops_rules.md, instructions/integration.md. A case-insensitive scan of instruction.md, both instruction notes and seed_data.json for criteri|rubric|judge|reward|/tests returned 0 matches in each file, so no rubric copy or grading key is shipped to the agent. solution/ is outside the agent build context. Verifier isolation: task.toml L26-28 '[verifier] ... environment_mode = "separate"'; tests/Dockerfile (template-identical) is the only image with @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @playwright/mcp, harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 (L16-31) and 'COPY . /tests' then 'chmod -R go-rwx /tests' (L43-44). Reward cannot be influenced by the submission except through app behaviour: test.sh (template-identical) sets umask 077 (L3), chmod 700 on LOG_DIR (L11), re-applies 'chmod -R go-rwx /tests' (L12), writes the zero reward first with an EXIT trap (L60-61), refuses symlinks outside /app/node_modules (L72-83), and launches the app as uid/gid 65534 with 'env -i' and a sanitized env (L104-111). So the running submission cannot read /tests prompts/criteria (root-only 0700) nor write $LOG_DIR/reward.txt/reward.json or the restart helper; reward is computed by /tests/tools/score.py from RewardKit output only. Attempted broken-app counterexamples: (1) app reading /tests/*/*/prompt.md to tailor output - denied by go-rwx as uid 65534; (2) app or agent planting reward.txt/reward.json - test.sh never reads anything from /app except server.js and the app cannot write the root-only LOG_DIR; (3) symlink /app/x -> /tests or /logs - test.sh exits with the zero reward (L81). Conforming alternative that could fail on this row's axis: none found; the symlink refusal could zero an app with an exotic out-of-node_modules symlink, but that is shared template policy not graded by this row. Residual injection via served UI text belongs to row 45. All shared harness files are byte-identical to the frozen template, so nothing task-specific weakens isolation. Evidence is source/structure only; no hosted run exercised a hostile app attempting to read /tests, which this structural row does not require.
